0=explorable | game link num 0=499 }} This is the first [[explorable area]] players will visit in the Far Shiverpeaks, and is the site of the mysterious tower, known as the [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]]. ==Getting there== This area can initially be entered from [[Boreal Station]] after doing the requisite quest to enter ''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North]]''. ==Exits== * ([[Johon's Longbow]]) ==Dialogue== * For the dialogue by [[Gwen]], see [[Gwen's garden]]. * For the dialogue related to the [[War in Kryta]], see [[War in Kryta dialogues]]. == Landmarks == * The [[ice column statue]] can be seen in the northeast of the zone. * [[Gwen's garden]] lies behind the Eye of the North. ==Notes== * The area outside [[Boreal Station]] is a popular place for [[chest run]]s or to farm [[experience]] (for [[pet]]s, [[hero]]es, your [[character]], or the [[Survivor]] title). ** It is almost completely safe: the [[Snow Wurm]]s spawn in fixed locations, they do little damage (even in [[Hard Mode]]), and they do not attack unless you attack them first. ** On average, a [[runner]] can reach two [[locked chest]]s in less than two minutes. * The [[portal]]s to the [[Battledepths]] and [[Norrhart Domains]] are closed until your character uses the [[Scrying Pool]] in the [[Hall of Monuments]] to view [[the First Vision]] cinematic. * This area is easier to map if either [[Service: In Defense of the Eye]] or [[Snowball Dominance]] are active. * The [[Ice Imp]]s and [[Stonewolf|Stonewolves]] are hostile to each other. *{{Vanquisher|count = 152|low = 141|high = 163}} ** The first time you visit this zone, a dialogue occurs between [[Jora]] and [[Sif Shadowhunter]], which prevents [[Tjorvi Throstson]] from spawning. If you want to get [[Norn Hunting Party|Norn blessing]] right away, rezone through [[Boreal Station]] before continuing. ** There are hidden [[Mountain Aloe]]s in the southern areas, mostly near the [[Mountain Pinesoul]]s. * In normal mode only a single group of [[Chilling Wisp]]s spawn on the central frozen lake, while in [[hard mode]] an additional group of Chilling Wisps and multiple groups of [[Ice Imp]]s spawn there too. ==Trivia== * The dialogue with Evennia was added as part of the [[Feedback:Game updates/20100506|May 06, 2010 update]]. {{Explorable areas in the Far Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Eisklippen-Abgründe]]
